source_limits: Brooks does not specify this exact rail, close conjunction, reclaim, expiry or lifecycle. These are preregistered own choices; review verifies faithful implementation, not exact author replication.

cases.rule: Equality with prior low/high is not a lower-low/higher-high countertrend bar.
Equal close is not a countertrend close; this conjunction is an own adaptation.
Touch of frozen pullback high/low is not strict later close beyond it.
Touch of adverse extreme is not breach; later strict reclaim remains valid.
Origin index20 and reclaim index30 is exactly10bars and remains eligible; expiry is greater-than10.
Close exactly at frozen rail cancels origin even before a shallow bar; later recovery must not revive it.
